raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #44895. For an `input_embeds` request, the scheduler fills in placeholder `input_ids` (`[1] * len(input_embeds)`) and the model runner passes both to the model. Gemma 3n and Gemma 4 check that exactly one of `input_ids` and `inputs_embeds` is given, so the check raises inside the scheduler and the server goes down. Their per-layer embeddings (always on in Gemma 3n, optional in Gemma 4) also need the real token ids, so these models can't run from embeddings alone.

## Modifications

- `models/gemma3n_causal.py`, `gemma3n_mm.py`, `gemma4_causal.py`, `gemma4_mm.py`: add `supports_input_embeds = False` to `Gemma3nForCausalLM`, `Gemma3nForConditionalGeneration`, `Gemma4ForCausalLM` and `Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration` (`Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration` inherits it). Same pattern as `supports_cuda_vmm_feature_transport`; other models default to supported.
- `model_loader/utils.py`: `supports_input_embeds(model_config)`, next to `supports_cuda_vmm_feature_transport`.
- `managers/tokenizer_manager.py`: `_tokenize_one_request` rejects an `input_embeds` request for such a model with a `ValueError`, which the HTTP server returns as a 400 (`input_embeds is not supported by this model's architecture (Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration). Send text or input_ids instead.`). The model class is resolved on the first `input_embeds` request and cached, so servers that never get one don't import it in the tokenizer process (the same lookup `_validate_cuda_vmm_feature_transport_support` already does there). Every `input_embeds` request (HTTP, `Engine`, gRPC, batch, multi-tokenizer workers) goes through `_tokenize_one_request`; the Rust server doesn't accept `input_embeds`.

### Open question: other multimodal models

As described in the issue, the other models that go through `general_mm_embed_routine` don't crash, but they don't use `input_embeds` either: `prepare_mm_inputs` computes embeddings from the placeholder ids and copies them over `forward_batch.input_embeds`, so the model generates from token id 1 repeated. This PR only covers the crash. If you'd like those models rejected too, I can add the flag to them here or in a follow-up; supporting embeddings properly in the multimodal path would be a separate change.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A: only `input_embeds` requests to Gemma 3n/4 are affected, and those crashed the server before.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A: one cached attribute check per `input_embeds` request.

## Validation

- New `test/registered/unit/managers/test_input_embeds_support.py` (CPU): 5 passed, 14 subtests. Covers the flag for all five Gemma 3n/4 architectures, Llama and Gemma 3 still supported, the request rejected in `_tokenize_one_request`, and the architecture resolved only once.
- Same request on main vs. this branch (CPU, tokenizer manager only): on main the Gemma 4 `input_embeds` request passes validation and goes on to the scheduler; with this PR it is rejected with the message above.
- `test_tokenizer_manager_rid_cleanup.py` and `test_io_struct.py`: 110 passed, same as main.
- `pre-commit run` on the changed files passes.

I did not run a Gemma 4 server on a GPU; the crash path itself is the one @riversky0014 reproduced in the issue.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@
+"""
+Unit tests for rejecting input_embeds requests on models that can't use them.
+
+Gemma 3n/4 forward() requires exactly one of input_ids and input_embeds, but an
+input_embeds request reaches it with placeholder input_ids as well, which used
+to kill the scheduler (#44895). The tokenizer manager now rejects such requests
+up front.
+"""
+
+import asyncio
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.configs.model_config import ModelImpl  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.managers.io_struct import GenerateReqInput  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_manager import TokenizerManager  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.model_loader import utils as model_loader_utils  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.model_loader.utils import supports_input_embeds  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context  # noqa: E402
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+UNSUPPORTED_ARCHS = [
+    "Gemma3nForCausalLM",
+    "Gemma3nForConditionalGeneration",
+    "Gemma4ForCausalLM",
+    "Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration",
+    "Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration",
+]
+SUPPORTED_ARCHS = ["LlamaForCausalLM", "Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration"]
+
+
+def _model_config(arch: str) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        hf_config=SimpleNamespace(architectures=[arch]),
+        quantization=None,
+        model_impl=ModelImpl.AUTO,
+        is_embedding_gemma=False,
+    )
+
+
+def _make_tokenizer_manager(arch: str) -> TokenizerManager:
+    tm = TokenizerManager.__new__(TokenizerManager)
+    tm.model_config = _model_config(arch)
+    tm.model_supports_input_embeds = None
+    return tm
+
+
+class TestSupportsInputEmbeds(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_gemma3n_and_gemma4_opt_out(self):
+        for arch in UNSUPPORTED_ARCHS:
+            with self.subTest(arch=arch):
+                self.assertFalse(supports_input_embeds(_model_config(arch)))
+
+    def test_other_models_default_to_supported(self):
+        for arch in SUPPORTED_ARCHS:
+            with self.subTest(arch=arch):
+                self.assertTrue(supports_input_embeds(_model_config(arch)))
+
+
+class TestTokenizerManagerRejectsInputEmbeds(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        override = get_context().override_server_args(disable_radix_cache=True)
+        override.install()
+        self.addCleanup(override.restore)
+
+    def test_input_embeds_request_is_rejected(self):
+        for arch in UNSUPPORTED_ARCHS:
+            with self.subTest(arch=arch):
+                tm = _make_tokenizer_manager(arch)
+                obj = GenerateReqInput(input_embeds=[[0.1, 0.2], [0.3, 0.4]])
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(
+                    ValueError, f"input_embeds is not supported.*{arch}"
+                ):
+                    asyncio.run(tm._tokenize_one_request(obj))
+
+    def test_supported_model_passes_the_check(self):
+        for arch in SUPPORTED_ARCHS:
+            with self.subTest(arch=arch):
+                _make_tokenizer_manager(arch)._validate_input_embeds_support()
+
+    def test_architecture_is_resolved_once(self):
+        tm = _make_tokenizer_manager("Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration")
+        with patch.object(
+            model_loader_utils,
+            "supports_input_embeds",
+            wraps=model_loader_utils.supports_input_embeds,
+        ) as resolve:
+            for _ in range(2):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                    tm._validate_input_embeds_support()
+        self.assertEqual(resolve.call_count, 1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
